summary: Each task forks a process; the default --forks=5 makes extra hosts wait, but more forks use more CPU and memory on the control node where network tasks run.
questions: How many forks should I use for network automation?
Why are only 5 hosts running at once?
Can increasing forks overload my laptop?

answer_card.title: Tune --forks
answer_card.answer_md: Default `--forks=5`: with 10 hosts, 5 wait for a free fork. Raise it to run more at once, but network tasks run on the control node, so more forks quickly consume CPU and memory there.
